Troubleshooting · 45/50 · archive

Archive restore test fails

Failure signal

A archive restore test fails condition is reported or detected during archive.

Likely cause

The controlling record, technical state or approved specification for archive does not match the current asset or workflow.

Verification

Test catalog lookup, media retrieval, checksum and application readability from a clean environment.

Corrective action

Repair from another verified copy and repeat a documented end-to-end restore.

Prevention

Add this verification to the archive gate, retain immutable evidence and assign one accountable owner.
